TextView.android:text:
Eccles Bluechat lets you chat, make voice calls and make video calls over Bluetooth, with no internet connection needed.

Bluetooth uses battery power, so the app does not start it automatically by default. Turn Bluetooth on before you use the app.

Permissions
• Location: only used to discover nearby devices. Bluechat never reads your location.
• Storage: needed to send and save images, audio and video.
• Microphone: needed for voice notes and calls.
• Camera: needed for photos and video calls.

On Android 10 or higher, grant “Allow management of all files” in Settings → Apps → Eccles Bluechat → Permissions if you want to open received files outside this app.

If you skip a permission, the feature that needs it may not work properly.

When you have finished, choose Exit from the options menu (top right) so the app releases the resources it is using.

If you run into a problem, open Settings → Send Feedback and tell us about it. We will do our best to fix it. For more help on using the app, open Help from the options menu.
